methodology.source: Working-tree content compared with the fixed Git main baseline; reused the previous local Markdown audit approach.
methodology.parser: Installed marked lexer with Markdown/reference links, images, HTML href/src, GitHub-style Unicode slugs, duplicate suffixes and explicit HTML anchors.
methodology.scope: All changed active project-authored Markdown, plus inbound references from other active documents and historical archives to those changed targets; architecture-and-design discussion form checked separately.
methodology.historical_policy: Verification, history and dated audit records are classified separately; immutable vendor/corpus material is excluded as an authored source.
methodology.network: No HTTP requests or external crawling.
methodology.limits: Only local repository targets and same-repository GitHub main URLs are resolved; non-Markdown fragments are counted but not validated. This is documentation-link evidence, not OS or CI acceptance.
